notes:
New/edit persona, saved via `set_use_cases` (`personas`). Same dialog shell as `usecases-edit-dialog`, 580px.

Fields: avatar (click the avatar to pick an emoji or type one; six colour swatches as a radiogroup, selected = ring), Name (autofocus) | Role (`chrome-field`: text input with a datalist of existing roles, free text, no chevron — CHR-1097), **Kind** (CHR-1146, ADR-011 persona `kind`: native `<select>` (`uc-select`) with Not stated / Human / Agent / Service / Organization, default Not stated = key omitted; hint "optional, shown as an icon next to the name"; the matching `uc-actor-kind` icon sits right of the select and updates with it), ID (derived from the name, mono, "from the name, stable once used"; read-only in edit mode), Description, Traits: one native `<select>` (`uc-select`) per dimension with scope Personas, text options only, default **Any** (placeholder style) = trait omitted; Goals (textarea, one per line → `goals[]`). Placeholders: role "Designer", goals "Find the screen a step maps to", description "Designs screens and writes use cases for them.".

Live hint under the traits (`role="status"`, ok green): when the chosen values are new to the pool, say so ("First persona with … It fills a gap in the pool."). Generated personas open in the same form with a "Generated" marker in the header. Edit mode adds a **Delete** button at the left of the footer (asks before deleting; the safe action gets focus).

Flows: close / Cancel / Create persona → `usecases-personas`.
